transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon, you have reached S-Net credit collections and cancellations, my name is Jason.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Jason, my name is Lydia Sterling. I received a formal disconnection warning letter in the post this morning stating my broadband will be terminated in forty-eight hours for non-payment, but my monthly direct debit of forty-eight pounds has been debited from my Santander account on the first of every single month without fail!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check your billing ledger and collection status. Before we inspect your records, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 88 Victoria Road, Swindon, SN1 3BD, and my security PIN is 7731. My customer account reference number is SN-991204.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Lydia, that confirms your account details. What specific invoice reference is quoted on the disconnection notice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It quotes notice reference DIS-440192, claiming October's invoice of forty-eight pounds is thirty days overdue!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query our central banking reconciliation portal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Lydia. The finance gateway indicates that October's payment was routed into an unallocated bank suspense ledger due to a truncated sort code on the Bacs payment file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My direct debit has been set up with the exact same bank details for four years! S-Net took forty-eight pounds from my Santander account on October 1st, and your system lost it in an internal suspense ledger! Now you threaten to cut off my broadband, which I need for my NHS nursing shift coordination! I am furious and panicking!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Electronic payment reconciliation is governed by national banking clearinghouse settlement files.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you remove the disconnection flag and allocate my forty-eight pounds from your suspense ledger right now?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline telephony representatives do not have access to transfer funds between corporate suspense accounts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me immediately to your finance ledger manager who can reallocate my payment!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Finance managers do not take customer phone calls. You must wait for the monthly audit cycle to reconcile suspense funds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait for the monthly audit?! The letter says my broadband will be cut off on Friday! Are you telling me S-Net will disconnect an NHS nurse because your internal computer truncated my sort code?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously automated collections workflows execute disconnection commands unless an account balance shows zero in the billing ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Stop quoting automated workflows and turn off the disconnection command right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the operational reality of our automated collection architecture.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are acting like a stupid customer if you think customer services can override automated collections without an approved bank statement audit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What did you say to me?! Are you completely out of your mind?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I stated that collections procedures cannot be manually overridden without verified bank statements.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you just call me stupid?! I am recording this phone call! I am an NHS sister and I will not be verbally abused by S-Net customer service! Give me your employee ID number right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My employee identification code is JS-4401. As I said, our automated billing software issues disconnection warnings whenever payments are not in the primary clearing account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: JS-4401, written down. I will be submitting this entire recording to your executive directors and the nursing union legal team today!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are entitled to submit formal written feedback through our online complaints portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the dispute ticket reference for this disconnection notice?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The formal billing dispute reference is CMP-88192-S.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: CMP-88192-S, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A suspension stay can only be granted if you email a PDF copy of your bank statement to billing audit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I should not have to send bank statements to prove a direct debit that S-Net already collected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the mandatory procedure enforced by our finance department.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I want this flagged for emergency review before close of business today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Emergency reviews are only scheduled for corporate business leased line accounts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is an absolute scandal. I have never missed a payment in my life.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The automated notification letter was triggered purely on automated ledger metrics.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have made an unbearable situation ten times worse with your insulting attitude.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our corporate customer relations team handles formal complaints within ten working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ten working days?! My broadband is scheduled to be cut off in forty-eight hours!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You have been advised of the documentation requirement to prevent suspension.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will be sending my Santander proof of payment directly to your chief executive's office.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Executive correspondence is redirected to the complaints resolution unit in Sunderland.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Make sure all your abusive remarks are retained in the audio recording.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was that customer account reference number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of the call, it is SN-991204.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your account reference on the complaints file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If my broadband is disconnected on Friday, S-Net will face formal legal proceedings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our legal affairs team responds to formal court proceedings through our registered legal office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will be taking this matter directly to the Communications Ombudsman.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ombudsman dispute reference packs are supplied upon issuance of a formal deadlock letter.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Issue me a deadlock letter immediately then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Deadlock letters can only be issued after eight weeks of unresolved formal complaint review.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Unbelievable bureaucracy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your billing account I can assist you with today, Lydia?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, you have been utterly abusive and useless.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
